title: Appointment Agreement Terms on the Missed First Appointment Fee Amount
content:
**Term.** The fee for a missed first appointment of an Appointment Series is the first-appointment no-show basis, and that basis is the no-show fee of the series' visit format. It is owed for the no-show recorded on the appointment dated on the series start date: where the series shows no no-show on that date, the amount is nil. The amount is rounded to the nearest cent once, as the last step.

**Records read.** The series start date and visit format from the series record, and the no-show entries on the series by appointment date.

**Illustrations (hypothetical figures).**

| Series record | Amount |
|---|---|
| No-show recorded on the series start date; format no-show fee USD 85.00 | USD 85.00 |
| No-show recorded on a later appointment only | nil for the first-appointment fee |
